from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A financial line item extracted from a company's filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name the filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial line item (e.g. 'Accounts receivable, net')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
